reader_question: Which parts of the atlas connect to which?
grade_line: The atlas’s own model: our count of its connections by region
title: Of the atlas’s 118 connections, 23 start in governing institutions, more than in any other region, and all 7 authority connections start there.
measure_line: Connections in the atlas’s model, counted by the region each starts in and the region it reaches, as of October 15, 2026
notes: A connection links two variables in the atlas’s model; a count says how many connections join two regions, not how strong they are.
Authority connections, such as a legislature setting a regulator’s powers, carry no plus or minus sign in the atlas, so they form their own class.
alt: A grid of the atlas’s ten regions, rows for where a connection starts and columns for where it ends, with 44 of the 100 cells holding connections. Governing institutions starts 23, the most, including all seven authority connections; outside drivers receives none.

table.caption: Connections in the atlas’s model by region, as of October 15, 2026

phone_note: On a phone the rows carry numbers, and the numbered region names follow the grid.
